system.description: You use your riding experience to improve your skills on a Speeder or a Swoop Bike. When riding a Speeder or a Swoop Bike (or another, similar Vehicle), you can use the following applications of the Ride skill: Fast Mount or Dismount, Soft Fall, Stay in Saddle, and Use Mount as Cover.
